name: cosmic-button
title: Cosmic Button
blurb: Animated rotating gradient border expands on hover.
description: A polymorphic link/button with a continuously rotating conic-gradient border and texture overlay that expands on hover, using CSS animations.
use_when: You need a striking hero CTA with constant motion that draws attention.
avoid_when: When motion distraction is a concern; the animation runs continuously regardless of interaction.
a11y: Supports focus-visible ring with offset. Polymorphic element type supports both link and button semantics. No prefers-reduced-motion guard; animation always runs.
